inputs.<tmp:0>/instructions/_schema.awawa:
SCHEMA TRIGGER
	DESC "a condition a session establishes"
	FIELD KIND task|path
		REQUIRED
	FIELD CONDITION string
		REQUIRED
	FIELD GLOB glob
		REPEATABLE
	FIELD LOADS @RULE
		REPEATABLE

SCHEMA RULE
	DESC "a rule"
	FIELD SPEC string
		REQUIRED
inputs.<tmp:0>/instructions/triggers.awawa:
TRIGGER cart_code
	KIND path
	CONDITION "a file of the cart"
	GLOB "src/cart/**"
	LOADS @RULE.cart_is_pure

TRIGGER billing_code
	KIND path
	CONDITION "a file of the billing"
	GLOB "src/billing/**"
	LOADS @RULE.charges_are_logged

TRIGGER shipping_code
	KIND path
	CONDITION "a file of the shipping"
	GLOB "src/shipping/**"
	LOADS @RULE.parcels_are_weighed

TRIGGER changing_code
	KIND task
	CONDITION "changing code"
	LOADS @RULE.cart_is_pure

TRIGGER cart_button_code
	KIND path
	CONDITION "the button of the cart"
	GLOB "src/cart/button.py"
	LOADS @RULE.cart_is_pure

RULE cart_is_pure
	SPEC "the cart computes without input or output"

RULE charges_are_logged
	SPEC "every charge is logged"

RULE parcels_are_weighed
	SPEC "every parcel is weighed"
